title: Research-only ORCA 3.0 product and release scope
authority: User supplied the research-only directive and requested the next implementation slice.
product_definition: A federated marine scientific research platform for authorized researchers, laboratories, independent reviewers and institutional agent operators.
included: institutional multi-tenancy, projects and protected scientific files
one bounded historical SST product and compatible baseline
deterministic SST computation, provenance, evidence and uncertainty
independent reproduction, review, challenge and immutable correction
independently operated A2A providers with ENSv2 authority and Arkiv coordination
excluded: public warnings, alerts and vessel route guidance
consumer conversation, voice, localization and personalized memory
general model registry, training jobs and reinforcement learning platform

gate_policy.current_blocker: G02 requires live dedicated staging PostGIS/RLS and object-store evidence
gate_policy.next_scientific_phase: P03 may start only after G02 passes

pending_specialist_signoffs: scientific SST product, baseline and method acceptance
A2A, ENSv2 and Arkiv version/network decisions before G09-G11
frontend navigation and global review-inbox contract decision
